q: Property (T) (Kazhdan's property, 1967) for a group Γ means every unitary representation with almost-invariant vectors has invariant vectors. For orbit equivalence, property (T) groups have the rigidity property that:
opts: They cannot be orbit equivalent to amenable group actions
Their Bernoulli actions are not OE to each other for different entropies
exp: Groups with property (T) are not OE-equivalent to amenable group actions (by CFW theorem, all amenable actions are OE to ℤ-actions). Property (T) prevents the 'softness' of amenable OE classes. Popa's work shows property (T) implies very strong rigidity for OE.
